mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and simultaneously nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a robust labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and simultaneously real GDP (GDPC1) shows negative growth over the past quarter, it signals a broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decrease > 1% and GDPC1 negative growth
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% and GDPC1 shows negative growth.
